answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because harbor only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice orchard is enforced by the ledger itself: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any inlet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
